purpose: Exact typed state families and reason codes for temporal comparison, so that every outcome is terminal, typed, reason-carrying and replayable. This is the document that closes the bare-string TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE defect.

reuse_discipline.statement: This lane creates NO new authority state. AUTHORITY_STATE / FAIL_CLOSED_STATES are reused unchanged: ALLOW (positive) plus DENY, DEFER, MISSING_AUTHORITY, UNKNOWN, OUT_OF_SCOPE, SUPERSEDED_NOT_REPLAYABLE, AUTHORITY_HASH_MISMATCH, AUTHORITY_SCOPE_MISMATCH (rawlsing_next/pre553_empirical_authority.py:54-57; rawlsing_next/pre553_empirical_objects.py:82-85).
reuse_discipline.why: The commission forbids sibling authority kinds unless necessity is proven. No new authority state was necessary either: the existing fail-closed states cover every nonpositive outcome of a temporal comparison. What was missing was the TEMPORAL-side comparison state family itself, which is distinct from AUTHORITY_STATE and is defined below.

TEMPORAL_RELATION_STATE.purpose: The overall typed state of one temporal relation receipt. This is the exact home of the promoted TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE.
TEMPORAL_RELATION_STATE.producer: The temporal comparison operation, under a bound TEMPORAL_COMPARABILITY authority.
TEMPORAL_RELATION_STATE.terminality_law: Every state is terminal for that receipt. A receipt is never left in an indeterminate state, and no state may be upgraded by re-running without new authority.

members.meaning: The pair is comparable under exact authority, the order basis yields a total order on this pair, and a direction claim is authorized.
members.pair_with: relation_status ORDERED_RELATION_AUTHORIZED and direction_claim INCREASE | DECREASE | NO_AUTHORIZED_CHANGE

members.meaning: The pair IS comparable under exact authority, but the bound order basis does not determine a direction for this particular pair. Comparability and direction are separate facts.
members.critical_noncollapse: This state is NOT TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE. A comparable pair with no claimable direction is a materially better situation than a noncomparable pair, and the two must never be merged.
members.pair_with: comparability_status COMPARABLE, relation_status ORDER_RELATION_REFUSED, direction_claim DIRECTION_NOT_CLAIMABLE

members.meaning: The ordered pair is not comparable under any bound authority. The refusal is itself a first-class typed observation, not an error and not an absence.
members.was_before: A bare string in FORBIDDEN_BACKFILL_TARGET_STATES at rawlsing_next/pre553_source_relations.py:54, with no producer, no schema and no reason code.
members.is_now: A produced, reason-carrying, terminal member of TEMPORAL_RELATION_STATE, placed at TEMPORAL_RELATION_RECEIPT.relation_state.

members.meaning: The two authorized interval refs overlap, so the order is partial and no direction is claimable for this pair. The refusal is typed and explicit, never a silent choice.
members.no_midpoint: Overlap MUST NOT be resolved to a midpoint. Doing so would fabricate an order the sources do not support.
members.distinguished_from: TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE. Overlapping intervals are a direction refusal on an otherwise comparable pair.

members.meaning: The persisting comparand is not exactly composed, so it cannot be asserted that both anchors concern the same thing.
members.note: No persisting object is named by any current authority. This lane does not create one; it requires that one be composed under TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE.

members.meaning: No permitted order basis from 04_TIME_ORDER_BASIS_LAW.json applies to this pair.
Fewer than two anchors authorized for this pair.
members.critical_noncollapse: Two anchors are SUFFICIENT for one ordered relation when all comparability authority is present. This state exists solely for fewer than two. There is NO state for three-or-more, because >=3 is NOT LAW and a longer chain is a sequence of separate two-anchor receipts.

members.meaning: The two observations are not the same estimand. A difference across different estimands is not a delta.
The two observations do not share a measure/weight design. A difference across incompatible measures is not a delta.
The pair crosses source universes but no exact SOURCE_EQUIVALENCE authority binds them. Distinct-by-default is preserved; no equivalence may be assumed.
Relating the two anchors' time representations requires family-scoped mapping material that is not adopted or not bound.
members.no_generalization: Family-scoped mapping material may never be generalized into a universal grain rule. The historically hard-coded EVS_WAVE_BY_YEAR table (data/ddm_build_copy/ddm_survey_identity.py:89) is an example and may not become one.

members.meaning: A required authority is absent. Fail-closed.
members.conserved_from: The historical TEMPORAL_INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY state (V553, SEMANTIC_F3) carries this meaning and is conserved by name and role.

TEMPORAL_ORDER_BASIS_STATE.purpose: Which order basis governs a pair. Values mirror 04_TIME_ORDER_BASIS_LAW.json.
TEMPORAL_ORDER_BASIS_STATE.independent_of_relation_state: The order basis state and the relation state are separate fields. A CALENDAR_TOTAL_ORDER basis can still yield TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE if the response surface is not shared.

DIRECTION_CLAIM_STATE.purpose: The reported direction, separate from authorization.
DIRECTION_CLAIM_STATE.critical_noncollapse: DIRECTION_NOT_CLAIMABLE is a first-class value. It is NOT an error, NOT a null, and NOT equivalent to NO_AUTHORIZED_CHANGE. A claimable absence of change is a positive finding; an unclaimable direction is a refusal.
DIRECTION_CLAIM_STATE.no_default_deadband: No deadband is inherited. If a deadband is used it must be bound by the comparability authority.

UNCERTAINTY_STATE_FOR_TEMPORAL_CLAIM.purpose: Uncertainty state of a temporal delta.
UNCERTAINTY_STATE_FOR_TEMPORAL_CLAIM.reuses_existing_law: UNCERTAINTY_UNQUANTIFIED reuses the existing enumerated state at rawlsing_next/pre553_empirical_objects.py:102-104.

INTERVENING_SPAN_STATE.purpose: Whether an unobserved span lies between the anchors.
INTERVENING_SPAN_STATE.law: A gap is preserved as typed unknown. It may not be filled, interpolated, or read as continuity. ABSENCE != ZERO and no silent interpolation is authorized.

RUPTURE_CANDIDATE_STATE.purpose: Typed candidate status only. NOT a temporal relation state and NOT produced by this contract.
RUPTURE_CANDIDATE_STATE.ceiling: A typed candidate under exact authority only.
RUPTURE_CANDIDATE_STATE.no_producer_authorized: No adopted authority produces a rupture candidate. This lane defines only the ceiling and the typed candidate slot. The historical V553 thresholds are NOT adopted and may not be imported.
RUPTURE_CANDIDATE_STATE.why_separate_from_relation_state: A rupture candidate is a claim about a change in kind, which requires its own authority and its own calibration. Folding it into TEMPORAL_COMPARABILITY would grant causal-adjacent power the commission explicitly withholds.

noncollapse_laws: AUTHORIZATION != DIRECTION: TEMPORAL_DIRECTIONAL_CLAIM_AUTHORIZED authorizes that a claim may be made; INCREASE/DECREASE is what it says.
COMPARABLE != ORDERABLE: TEMPORAL_COMPARABLE_NO_DIRECTION is a comparable pair.
NONCOMPARABLE != NO_CHANGE: TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE is a refusal, never a finding of no change.
ABSENCE != ZERO: an absent delta, an intervening gap and an unobserved span are typed unknowns, never zeros.
DIFFERENCE != TRAJECTORY: no trajectory object is authorized.
TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE != SOURCE_NONCOMPARABLE: different object, different producer, different scope.
LIMIT != NEGATION: a temporal limit does not erase an independent non-temporal fact.
downstream_scr553_note: Existing M1 states NO_POSITIVE_V553_OUTPUT__MISSING_TEMPORAL_AUTHORITY, __MISSING_COMPARABILITY_AUTHORITY and INELIGIBLE_TEMPORAL_SIGNATURE (rawlsing_next/m1_temporal_v554_admission_dedup.py:50-57,83,240-247) remain binding and are NOT superseded by this vocabulary. This contract defines the authority beneath them; it does not replace the existing downstream refusal language.
